scientific_integrity.historical_date_evidence: September 27, 2011 is the independently verified day-specific first online journal date of the motivating correlated-testing article. A UNC archive describes an October 2010 working paper, but does not verify an exact day for its public release; no day was imputed to that preprint.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: All integer sizes \(k\ge2\) with \(0<a<\min\{1,\tau\}\); prevalence \(p\downarrow0\) with fixed \(\tau>0\).
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Standalone Python-3 exact-rational checker included; finite checking is not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Perfect equal-cost assays, identical group sizes, fixed positive intracluster correlation, and no feasible maximum group size are assumed.
No risk reduction, diagnostic error, prevalence-estimation efficiency, or finite-population feasibility is established.
A source paper with the identical beta-binomial model could not be read in full; it creates genuine residual novelty uncertainty.
title: Inverse-prevalence optimal pools for positively correlated disease screening
